description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the UserDao class within the OrangeHRM HRM system, specifically testing database interactions related to User entities, such as saving users, checking user existence, and retrieving user-related data.

classes.name: UserDaoTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for UserDao, testing user data management functionalities.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes UserDao instance, sets fixture path, and populates test database with fixture data.

methods.name: getUserRole
methods.description: Retrieves UserRole entity by ID for use in tests.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Retrieves Employee entity by Employee Number for use in tests.

methods.name: testSaveSystemUser
methods.description: Tests saving a new User entity and verifies persistence.

methods.name: testIsExistingSystemUserForNonExistingUser
methods.description: Tests user existence check for a non-existing username.

methods.name: testIsExistingSystemUserForExistingUser
methods.description: Tests user existence check for an existing username.

methods.name: testIsExistingSystemUserForDeletedUser
methods.description: Tests user existence check when the user is marked as deleted.

methods.name: testIsExistingSystemUserForEmptyPasswordUser
methods.description: Tests user existence check for a user with an empty password.

methods.name: testGetSystemUser
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of a User entity by ID.

methods.name: testGetSystemUserForNonExistingId
methods.description: Verifies retrieval returns null for non-existing User ID.

methods.name: testGetAssignableUserRoles
methods.description: Checks retrieval of assignable user roles.

methods.name: testGetSystemUserIdList
methods.description: Verifies the list of system user IDs.

methods.name: testGetSystemUserIdListForOneActiveUser
methods.description: Ensures the list excludes deleted users.

methods.name: testGetEmployeesByUserRole
methods.description: Checks fetching employees by role with different filter options.
